subject: Track S time split built
body: Pushed fbf776f. python3 -m autoresearch.taste.timesplit build --researcher <slug> --cutoff YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run] writes data/researchers/<slug>/history_timesplit.jsonl and heldout_timesplit.jsonl as Choice rows (source=timesplit, decision_point=D1); review drops pairs a person rejects. Needs a dated corpus (publishedDate front matter), which scrape_exa must write. Track S E2 runner not built yet.
